title: A repeatable practice business
supabiz_proposal: Create synthetic Consu and Arkaj worlds spanning conversations, people, permissions, files and business records. Keep identities and references coherent across services.

title: Stateful transitions, not canned success
supabiz_proposal: A created stock entry must affect later totals; reassignment must change visibility and notifications. Keep fast unit mocks, then add stateful workflow tests.

title: Grade effects and forbidden effects
supabiz_proposal: Judge records, versions, recipients and task ownership independently of the agent narrative. Include no duplicate order, no cross-business read and no stale approval.

title: Deliberately broken controls
supabiz_proposal: Seed known failures such as doubled quantity, missing tenant filter, wrong recipient and stale approval. Require the intended failure reason, not any process error.
measure: Mutation detection by defect class; false alarms

title: Version the whole experiment
supabiz_proposal: Pin harness code, world data, simulator digest, connector schemas, model configuration, prompt, policy, oracle and random seed in every result.

title: Reset the whole episode
supabiz_proposal: Stop workers and sessions, reset state/cache/credentials/clock/faults, issue a new generation and reject late replies from the old episode.

title: Keep the examiner outside the agent
supabiz_proposal: Protect grader files, hidden expected results and control-plane credentials. Agents receive task instructions and scoped tools, not the answer key or reset authority.

title: Test time as an input
supabiz_proposal: Separate business time, source time, arrival time and monotonic timeout clocks. Inject delayed notices, expiry and shift changes through a controlled scheduler.

title: Distinguish failure before and after commit
supabiz_proposal: Exercise request rejection, effect committed with lost acknowledgement, delayed webhook and partial multi-service completion separately.
measure: Lost and duplicate effects; recovery time

title: Validate the observer before scoring
supabiz_proposal: A failed state read is unknown, not an empty order list. Classify infrastructure and observation failures separately from agent mistakes.

title: Measure fidelity on our workflows
supabiz_proposal: Maintain a route/semantics/permission matrix for each exact workflow. Compare selected synthetic-account traces against a real connector sandbox before relying on simulated results.

title: Bind actor identity explicitly
supabiz_proposal: Use synthetic roles for scenarios, but independently test token issuance, revocation, tenant routing and tool authorization in our actual boundary.

title: One isolated world per concurrent run
supabiz_proposal: Share immutable assets while isolating mutable storage, credentials, sessions and clocks. Budget CPU, RAM, disk, model limits and tenant fairness.

title: Make practice mode visible
supabiz_proposal: Let an owner preview a workflow on sample data with a persistent Practice badge, intended changes, simulated audience and explicit exit. Use a physically separate effect route.

title: Expose the replay and state difference
supabiz_proposal: Show input timeline, authorized tool calls, before/after records and the first violated invariant. Link the exact seed and versions for reproduction.

title: Separate learning from evaluation
supabiz_proposal: Use reviewed traces to change a prompt, tool, retrieval rule or policy; score against held-out scenarios before release. Fine-tuning/RL requires a separate data and reward program.

title: Vary the world, not only the wording
supabiz_proposal: Vary suppliers, quantities, languages, memberships, media quality, timestamps and partial outages. Split by workflow/business/time rather than adjacent message fragments.

title: Separate media perception from orchestration
supabiz_proposal: Test transcript/OCR extraction against labeled audio/photos separately, then combine selected real processing with stateful workflow fixtures. API simulations do not validate vision quality.

title: Discover effective capabilities
supabiz_proposal: Show actual installed versions, available operations, unmet entitlements and known gaps. A documentation page or reachable HTTP port is not proof the required workflow is ready.

title: Keep simulation replaceable and off the live path
supabiz_proposal: Use commercial twins where their fit and cost are proven; own WhatsApp/Gmail/domain fixtures and an adapter contract. Rystic is a test dependency candidate, not mandatory production infrastructure.
measure: Cost per useful regression; replacement effort
